census_fix.statement: base populations counted separately: maker-fill rows (maker legs) and take records (aggregated take records) are different units, never summed; mint / multi-record / merge / self-trade / sweep are overlapping attributes of take records, not executions

collisions.unit: raw takes sharing a (destination) second beyond the first; the shift is a bijection within its pair

pooled.reading_text: inventory size as a trimming trigger: WITHDRAWN as a maker rule (no further bins or variants are tried)
pooled.rule: PRIMARY O1 RR_size (|q| > 200 vs (0, 50]), pooled, D0, full panel. Its v1 verdict not supported -> withdrawn; supported in all six views {full, clean} x {D0, D1000, pend} -> qualified_candidate_association (the conservative reading of: full panel AND clean-ledger subset AND D1000 AND pending legs; the four named views are reported beside); otherwise unidentified. Rank 1 the same (secondary).

rank1.reading_text: inventory size as a trimming trigger: WITHDRAWN as a maker rule (no further bins or variants are tried)
rank1.rule: PRIMARY O1 RR_size (|q| > 200 vs (0, 50]), pooled, D0, full panel. Its v1 verdict not supported -> withdrawn; supported in all six views {full, clean} x {D0, D1000, pend} -> qualified_candidate_association (the conservative reading of: full panel AND clean-ledger subset AND D1000 AND pending legs; the four named views are reported beside); otherwise unidentified. Rank 1 the same (secondary).

multiplicity.clocks: D0 primary; D1000 and pend sensitivities (not counted)

naming.O1: a direction relative to the reconstructed anchor inventory, not proof that the take reduced the maker's private inventory
naming.anchor: fixed market-second, pre-earliest-match proxy (t < x_lo_hard_ms <= t + 1000); not an identified decision time
naming.inventory: q(t) = reconstructed venue inventory (status-ok legs with hi <= t); not client-known inventory

null.O1_O2: raw side-specific schedule: each pair's raw takes shifted with their sides by its offset, the direction re-derived at the destination second's q of the clock in use, de-duplicated per destination second
null.O3_O4: v1-style shift of the outcome (event-second) vector, the benchmark only
null.offsets: take_logic.assemble: Generator(PCG64(SeedSequence([seed, day, mid, rank]))).integers(0, n) per pair (n = 300 instants)
null.p_hi: (1 + #{null >= obs}) / (n_shifts + 1); NaN replicates counted on both sides; ties within 1e-12 relative

variants.rule: take_class == chain_take.combine(cls_rec, cls_cert_0, cls_sim) on every row

rules.clean_panel: maker-seconds with no earlier excluded leg (inv_ledger_conditional False at t; the D0 flag for every clock)
rules.decision: PRIMARY O1 RR_size (|q| > 200 vs (0, 50]), pooled, D0, full panel. Its v1 verdict not supported -> withdrawn; supported in all six views {full, clean} x {D0, D1000, pend} -> qualified_candidate_association (the conservative reading of: full panel AND clean-ledger subset AND D1000 AND pending legs; the four named views are reported beside); otherwise unidentified. Rank 1 the same (secondary).
rules.verdict: take_logic.verdict (v1): insufficient_support (< 5 supported markets or < 30 informative event-seconds) | supported (RR > 1, p_hi <= 0.05, RR > 1 in >= 2/3 of the supported markets) | inconsistent | not_supported

stated_as_data.definition: v1 type reduce (reduce_partial / full_close / reversal_reducing / overshoot) with side == sign(q(t)) at the anchor; stated as data, not removed
